title: Make ledger restoration coherent and crash-recoverable
description: The October 18 integration audit found that ledger settle restored canonical records separately from events and could leave a partial ledger on interruption. Writes are disabled in 0.11.0; dry-run remains supported. Design and implement one coherent restoration transaction through store.ts, preserving staged work, record/event consistency and recoverable snapshots. Re-enable CLI/MCP writes only when the failure cases pass. Do not restore only a subset of a multi-record mutation or discard unrelated writers. See docs/audit-integration-2026-10-18.md
acceptance: Interrupted restoration recovers deterministically with a real separate-process fixture.
Partial branch coverage, staged differences and outstanding writers cannot cause record/event divergence or loss.
The index and unrelated work are preserved; dry-run performs no canonical mutation or recovery.
CLI and MCP return equivalent coded results and all project checks pass.
notes: New priority-one follow-up from integration audit. Actor-only commits reject co-written files; coordinate complete history rather than weakening that refusal.
